notes: New record: no Chinese domestic physical-machine record exists in dossier/compute, and this is the cheapest large-RAM bare metal found in the wave at CNY 219 for 64 GB. The date is the part a reader must see first: the ladder is dated 2025-07-14 and a second post of 2025-07-07 carries the same figures word for word, so the price is fifteen months old at the time of reading and may have moved. The verdict is fails-identity and the reason is the one the corpus exists to catch: the machines are in mainland China and are sold against a Chinese IDC licence (the vendor quotes MIIT licence B1-20203595 in its own post), so provisioning runs against a real-name registered account. A currency conversion is deliberately not given because the rate on the day is unquoted. The reseller table prices the same box at 299 CNY with 30M BGP against the vendor's 219 with 20M Telecom, which is the usual gap between a carrier port and a BGP blend and should not be read as a contradiction.
